limits: Controlled native partial states use Commander registrations, not complete deck/pregame fixtures.
Only the marked face-down reset callback is reconstructed; other callback kinds and mid-resolution continuations remain unvalidated.
Merged/mutated object groups, specialized/perpetual states and every alternate-cost mechanic require separate validation.
All hidden-view identifiers, once-per-turn ability identities and AI policy choices remain unvalidated by these fixtures.
The official rules reference is versioned and limited to the named form rules, not a complete current-rules audit.
Native construction and selected interaction witnesses do not certify every card or combination.
